svg.text: Finding z for a 95% confidence level
Look up the area to the LEFT of +z in the z-table: (1 + CL)/2 = (1 + 0.95)/2 = 0.975.
The other 5% is split between the two tails.
2. The z-table wants the area to the LEFT
Other levels work the same way: 90% → left area 0.95 → z = 1.645, 99% → left area 0.995 → z = 2.575.
